messages:
tariq: Quick question I have a teammate in APAC with a local "floating" holiday on Dec 28 but our global year-end freeze is Dec 24-31. They want to take that day on Jan 6 instead so they can run an interview loop. Is that a swap or do we need to do a formal carryover?

anelise: You can treat this as a one-time holiday swap if the manager signs off and you submit before the blackout cutoff. Otherwise it needs escalation as a carryover exception. Please include a brief coverage plan.

vikram: Also note payroll: if the moved day causes their accrued balance to exceed the carryover cap, select "carryover exception" on the Time-off Adjustment form so Payroll can handle it manually.

people-ops-bot: FYI: Year-end blackout for unscheduled PTO = Dec 24-31 UTC. Submit swaps before Dec 23 to avoid escalation. Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/year-end

recruiting: If you're covering interviews, post the change in #recruiting and update the panel invites. We keep a backup interviewer list for holiday weeks.

tariq: Manager approved and I filed the Time-off Adjustment (submitted 2515003235). Attached manager approval and noted "Recruiting backup: Priya" in coverage_plan. Thanks!

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-5244 (floating holiday swap). Assigned to Anelise.
